report:
1. The Sahara covers roughly 80% of Algeria's land area.
2. Algeria's nominal GDP is estimated at about US$288 billion for 2025. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
3. Algeria beat Senegal 1–0 in the 2019 Africa Cup of Nations final, winning its second continental title and its first since 1990. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_Africa_Cup_of_Nations_final)
4. Since the GERD came online, Ethiopia's national electricity access rate has risen to about 55%. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
5. The World Bank expects Algeria's economy to grow 3.4% in 2025. [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/algeria/publication/algeria-economic-update-spring-2031)
6. Morocco joined OPEC in 1969. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
7. Algeria's government debt stood at 46.0% of GDP in 2019. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
8. The 2019 Africa Cup of Nations final at Cairo International Stadium was watched by 95,000 spectators. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_Africa_Cup_of_Nations_final)
9. At full supply level, the GERD reservoir has a surface area of roughly 1,900 km². [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
10. Hydrocarbon rents account for about 60% of Algeria's government revenue and 90% of its export revenue. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
11. Constantine's tramway carried around 10 million passengers in 2019. [Wikipédia](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tramway_de_Constantine)
12. Under the WHO definition, a meningococcal epidemic in the African belt means at least 100 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in a year. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meningitis_belt)
13. The 2019 Africa Cup of Nations was the first edition of the tournament contested by 24 teams. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_Africa_Cup_of_Nations_final)
14. With an installed capacity of 5.15 GW, Sudan's Merowe Dam is the largest hydroelectric power plant in Africa. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
15. Constantine's tramway runs 37 Citadis 402 trainsets built by Alstom in Spain. [Wikipédia](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tramway_de_Constantine)
16. Sonatrach, Algeria's state oil and gas company, employs more than 50,000 people. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy_of_Algeria)
17. The Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam is a gravity dam on the Blue Nile in Ethiopia's Benishangul-Gumuz Region, close to the Sudanese border. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
18. A US$3.8 billion contract to build the GERD was awarded to Salini Impregilo without competitive bidding. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
19. More than 90,000 meningitis cases were reported in the African meningitis belt in 2009. [WHO](https://www.who.int)
20. By October 2019, construction of the GERD was more than 75% complete. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Ethiopian_Renaissance_Dam)
